newsitem.title: USA: Porta Systems names chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Porta Systems names chairman, CEO.

text.p: Porta Systems Corp said on Wednesday William Carney was elected chairman and chief executive officer and Seymour Joffe as president and chief operating officer.
Carney and Joffe replaced Warren Esanu, as Chairman, and Edward Olson, as chief operating officer, both of whom have resigned, Porta Systems said.
Carney is the long-time vice chairman of the company and has held several operating positions at the company, Porta Systems said.
Joffe is a former director of the company who has most recently served the company as senior consultant to its operations support systems business, Porta Systems said.

Also, Edward Kornfeld, chief financial officer, was promoted to Senior Vice President - Operations to reflect his assumption of additional operating responsibilities while retaining his responsibilities as chief financial officer, the company said.

Esanu will continue to serve as counsel to the company and Olson continues to serve as a principal of KPMG BayMark Strategies LLC, which will continue to advise the Company through at least January 31, 1997.
